name: Kaiser
summary: Four-player partnership trick-taking game with a 32-card deck featuring the five of hearts and three of spades.
rules_text: Four players form two fixed partnerships sitting opposite. Use 32 cards: 8-A in each suit plus 7C, 7D, 5H and 3S. Deal 8 cards to each player. Players bid in order for the right to name trump; bids are a number of points, minimum typically 5-8, with 12 no-trump as Kaiser being highest. Highest bidder names trump suit or no-trump and leads. Play 8 tricks: must follow suit if able, otherwise may trump or discard. Highest trump wins trick, else highest of led suit. The partnership that wins the bid must make at least its bid in points, with the 5H and 3S as special scoring cards, or it is set. Points are scored and next hand dealt.
